    #o777777000000 ==> BIGNUM!!!!!!
Yes, this is quite right.  From  NIL;RP > (the reader-printer syntax)
  "      1.1.5) Unsigned machine word:  #*C4BD96AC*   #*777777*  
		  The "#*" prefix indicates this mode, and * serves as a kind
		  of delimiter for the numeric string.
  "
whereas #O is merely an abbreviation for #8R...  which is radix 8.
